subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge note, and compact evidence matrix
messages:
From: Kayla Jones <kayla@pioneeranalytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@pioneeranalytics.com
Date: Mon, 10 Sep 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II and bridge letter — initial ask

Hi Hannah,

We are evaluating Redwood for a pilot that will process de-identified telemetry and model outputs. Our security/compliance team needs the latest SOC 2 Type II report covering the services in scope, plus any bridge letter if the report period doesn't match our procurement window. To keep the intake small, could you provide:

- The SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and date range covered
- A short bridge letter / statement if the coverage ends before Q4 2028
- A compact evidence matrix (CSV or spreadsheet) listing minimal artifacts we can request (log samples, retention policy snippets, access control screenshots)
- Preferred secure transfer methods (SFTP, SharePoint, Drive link) and contact for a dedicated upload

We're aiming to complete our security review by Sep 22. If possible, include a short reply template we can use to request items from our procurement review team.

Thanks — appreciate a quick path to the minimal set.

Best,
Kayla Jones
Head of IT Compliance
Pioneer Analytics
[phone redacted]
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
To: Kayla Jones <kayla@pioneeranalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Sep 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and bridge letter — initial ask

Hi Kayla,

Thanks for the clear list — we can get this over quickly. Quick answers up front:

- Report: We have a SOC 2 Type II report for the period 2027-07-01 to 2028-06-30. PDF attached (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Summary.pdf).
- Bridge letter: We can provide a concise bridge letter that confirms controls remained in place after the report period through a specified cutoff; draft attached.
- Minimal evidence matrix: Attached a compact CSV (evidence_matrix_minimal.csv) with the recommended low-friction artifacts for an intake.
- Transfer: We support pre-signed S3 links, SFTP to a dedicated intake bucket, or a password-protected Drive folder. For this request Ben will coordinate SFTP details.

I'll paste a short reply template you can use internally, plus a one-line redaction guidance note.

--- Reply template (copy/paste for procurement/security) ---
Subject: Request: Redwood Inference SOC 2 Type II artifacts

Hi team,

We are requesting the following minimal artifacts from vendor Redwood Inference to complete our security review:
- SOC 2 Type II report (report period: 2027-07-01 to 2028-06-30)
- Bridge letter confirming post-report controls (if needed)
- Minimal evidence matrix (log sample, retention policy excerpt, IAM/config screenshots)

Please review and let me know if additional approvals are needed.

Thanks,
Kayla
---

Ben / Monica — can one of you send the SFTP user details and a short checklist for what we mark as non-sensitive vs. redaction-eligible? Prefer to keep the first intake under 10 items.

Atts: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Summary.pdf, evidence_matrix_minimal.csv

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Kayla Jones <kayla@pioneeranalytics.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Sep 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and bridge letter — initial ask

Kayla / Hannah — looping in a secure intake path.

We can provision a temporary SFTP account scoped to a single intake folder. Details:
- Host: sftp.redwood-inference.com
- Username: pioneer_pa_upload_0910
- Expiry: 14 days after creation
- Max file size: 500 MB (zip recommended)

Checklist for the compact intake (please include one artifact per bullet):
1) SOC 2 Type II PDF (already attached by Hannah)
2) Bridge letter (signed PDF) or signed email if faster
3) Retention policy excerpt (policy name + screenshot or PDF pages)
4) One week of event log sample (redacted PII) — README with sampling method
5) IAM/roles screenshot showing admin group membership
6) A single page outlining encryption-at-rest configuration (KMS/HSM note ok)

Monica — can you confirm which internal reviewer will be the single point for crypto/encryption questions? I'll create the SFTP credentials once we confirm.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Kayla Jones <kayla@pioneeranalytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Sep 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and bridge letter — initial ask

Thanks Ben / Hannah — that path works. We'll use SFTP as suggested. Action items on our side:
- I'll request internal approval to accept a temporary SFTP upload (procurement ok)
- Security will review the minimal evidence matrix and send any clarifying questions by Sep 15
- Please send SFTP credentials and a short upload README when ready

If you can get the bridge letter as a signed PDF, that will speed approval. I'll confirm the HubSpot deal once we receive the SFTP link.

Best,
Kayla
Pioneer Analytics
